name: @ahpd/computer
description: Disposable machines for agent sessions, on Docker, VMs or ssh boxes. Run it as an ahpd plugin.
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Computer
ahpd.description: Isolated machines for agent sessions: Docker containers, libvirt or Proxmox VMs, and ssh boxes.

closers: the up time of every running machine

runtime.description: How machines are provided. 'docker' (default) creates them; 'ssh' only lists the boxes in ssh.

command.description: The program that runs machines. Defaults to 'docker'.

args.description: Arguments placed before the program's own, for a wrapper or a Docker context.

ssh.description: Boxes this host reaches over ssh. They are listed, never created, started or removed here. A session on one starts its host from the ahpd this host installs in the user's folder there.

command.description: The program that reaches a box. Defaults to 'ssh'.

args.description: Arguments placed before ssh's own, for a wrapper or a jump host.

connectTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for a box before giving up. Defaults to 30.

pollSeconds.description: Seconds between checks of each box, so its up time is billed up to the last check. Without it, only a listing updates the meter.

machines.description: The boxes, by name. The entry 'dev02' becomes the machine 'ssh.dev02'.

destination.description: The ssh host: user@host, or a name from your ssh config. An entry without one is dropped.

port.description: The ssh port, when it is not ssh's own default.

identity.description: The private key to connect with, when ssh would not pick one itself.

workdir.description: Where commands start on the box. Defaults to the login directory, so paths from this host do not apply.

host.description: The command that starts a nested host on the box, run as written. Defaults to the ahpd this host installs in the user's folder there.

agents.description: The agents the box is prepared for. Sessions of other agents are refused.

libvirt.description: VMs for profiles with runtime 'libvirt': linked clones of a template disk on the server's libvirt, reached over ssh through that server.

uri.description: The libvirt connection URI for every server. Defaults to 'qemu+ssh://<destination>/system'.

pool.description: The storage pool for the template and every VM disk.

network.description: The libvirt network VMs attach to.

template.description: The template volume every VM disk is cloned from. Without it, a template is built from image on each server, with the parts this host's Docker builds.

image.description: A qcow2 cloud image with cloud-init, used to build the template. Set this or template, or VMs are refused.

user.description: The login VMs are created with. Defaults to 'ahpd'.

disk.description: VM disk size, in virsh vol-create-as format. Defaults to '20G'.

virsh.description: The virsh program and its leading arguments. Defaults to ["virsh"].

virtInstall.description: The virt-install program and its leading arguments. Defaults to ["virt-install"].

proxmox.description: VMs for profiles with runtime 'proxmox': linked clones of a template VM on this node, reached over ssh at the address the guest agent reports, through the profile's server when it names one.

url.description: The Proxmox API address, such as https://<node>:8006.

secret.description: The API token secret, or a vault reference such as {"$secret": "host:proxmox"}.

node.description: The node VMs are created on.

storage.description: The storage a template built here is copied to.

bridge.description: The network bridge for each VM's network card.

template.description: A template VM on the node, with cloud-init and the QEMU guest agent, that every VM is cloned from. Without it, a template is built from image, with the parts this host's Docker builds.

image.description: A cloud-init template VM on the node, with the QEMU guest agent, used to build the template. Set this or template, or VMs are refused.

user.description: The login VMs are created with. Defaults to 'ahpd'.

ca.description: A PEM file on this host to verify the node's certificate, for a node with its own certificate authority.

env.description: Environment variables added over the daemon's. Values are treated as secrets and shown as <set>.

image.description: The image machines are created from when none is named. Defaults to 'debian:bookworm-slim'.

cpus.description: CPU limit for every machine, as Docker's --cpus takes it.

memory.description: Memory limit for every machine, as Docker's --memory takes it.

max.description: Most machines that may exist at once when the agent's tool asks for another. Defaults to 3.

label.description: The label every machine carries. Defaults to 'ahpd.computer=1'.

prefix.description: Prefix for every machine name. Defaults to 'ahpd-computer'.

sessionSetting.description: Show a session setting for the machine a session runs in. On by default.

sessionDefault.description: The default machine for that setting, as a computer://<id> URI.

needs.description: Values for agents' machine needs, by need name.

mounts.description: Mounts every machine from this plugin gets.

title.description: The name shown in the picker. Defaults to the profile name.

description.description: One line about what it is for, a string.

image.description: The image its machines use. Defaults to the plugin's image.

cpus.description: CPU limit for its machines. Defaults to the plugin's cpus.

memory.description: Memory limit for its machines. Defaults to the plugin's memory.

ociRuntime.description: The OCI runtime Docker uses for its machines, such as 'runsc' for gVisor. Defaults to Docker's own.

runtime.description: What creates its machines. 'docker' (default) runs a container on the server's Docker; 'libvirt' and 'proxmox' create a VM, as those options set up.

server.description: The box its machines run on, by its name in ssh.machines. The box is checked first. Defaults to this host.

code.description: How a machine on a server gets the session's code. 'bundle' (default) sends the commit from this host; 'clone' fetches the branch from origin over https, so public repositories only.

workdir.description: Where commands start. Defaults to folder, or the image's own working directory.

mounts.description: Mounts added after the plugin's own.

agents.description: The agents its machines are prepared for, by provider id. Sessions of other agents are refused.

folder.description: A host folder mounted at the same path inside the machine.

host.description: The command that starts the nested host inside its machines. Defaults to ["ahpd"].

disposable.description: Create a machine only when a session starts, one per session. Off by default.

disposableDelay.description: Milliseconds a disposable machine stays after its last session leaves. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes).

disposableAlone.description: Hide disposable machines from the picker, so only their own session runs in them. Off by default.

sessionFolder.description: Mount the session's working folder read-write at the same path inside the machine. Off by default.

sessionRepository.description: Also mount the repository that folder belongs to. Needs sessionFolder. Off by default.

sessionTree.description: How the machine sees the repository. 'shared' (default) mounts this host's tree; 'copy' gives it its own checkout that reaches the host only by fetch. Needs sessionFolder.

parts.description: The parts every machine from this profile carries, by their ids in the versions file.

secretUnreadable.description: What happens when a vault value for a need cannot be read after a restart. 'fail' (default) fails every command in the machine; 'drop' leaves that variable out and logs it.

state.description: Where its agents keep their state. 'volume' (default) uses a named volume per provider, seeded from this host; 'host' mounts this host's own configuration.

stateScope.description: Who shares a state volume. 'owner' (default) gives each machine owner one; 'shared' gives the whole profile one.

gitGuard.description: How a git directory in a session's machine is guarded: fetch, the machine committing in a git directory of its own so the host fetches the work back, or open, the host's git directory writable in the machine. fetch when absent.

nestedDelete.description: What deleting a stopped session from this profile does. 'inside' (default) starts the machine's host to delete it there too; 'record' deletes it here and keeps the machine's copy.

profiles.description: Named machine setups a person picks from when creating a machine.

bodyMounts.description: Let a person name their own mounts when creating a machine. Off by default.

imageMounts.description: Let a part mount from its own image. Set to false to mount every part from a volume filled once from it.

images.description: Images machines may be created from, as containers-policy.json image scopes: docker.io/library/node:22 (one image), docker.io/library/node (a repository), ghcr.io/acme (a namespace), ghcr.io (a registry), *.example.com (its subdomains). Without it, any image is allowed.

source.description: A module specifier, or a path to a directory or file.

name.description: The name a listing shows, or the module in an entry written before source existed.

enabled.description: Set to false to skip the plugin. On by default.

grants.description: What the plugin may do when it connects as its own client.

plugins.description: The plugins the host inside the machine runs. Name at least one, or that host has no backend.

devcontainer.description: The Dev Container CLI, as a launcher and a machine maker, and the folders it may build from. Set to false to turn dev containers off.
